newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austrian 1996 public debt 70 pct of GDP - report.
newsitem.headline: Austrian 1996 public debt 70 pct of GDP - report.

text.p: Austrian public debt stood at 1,692 billion schillings, or 70 percent of GDP, last year and the budget deficit at 3.8 percent of GDP, the finance committee said in a report on Monday.
Echoing government forecasts, the committee said this year's public debt would decline towards the Maastricht Treaty's reference of 60 percent of GDP. -- Vienna newsroom, +43-1 531 12 254
